definition: to stop blaming someone and forgive them
description: Two young men stand on a suburban pavement beside a low brick wall with a road bike leaning against it. One in a navy hoodie stands with his arms folded tight and his jaw set, refusing to look up. The other, in black with a takeaway coffee cup, leans on the wall and talks to him steadily. The folded arms drop, the first one looks down and half-smiles, and the two step together into a long hug over the wall.

taps.target: the man in the blue hoodie
